newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CST Q1 net rises to $17.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CST Q1 net rises to $17.1 mln.

text.p: Brazilian steelmaker Companhia Siderurgica de Tubarao (CST) released the following first-quarter 1997 results.
Note: All figures are in Brazilian reais.

In a statement, CST said the improved result, including a 35-percent rise in net profit in reais, was due to 13.8 percent higher prices for steel slabs on international markets and a seven percent reduction in industrial costs in dollar terms.
The company said virtually all of its total estimated 1997 output of 3.4 million tonnes has been sold, with 80 percent already contracted at dollar prices eight percent higher than 1996.
